name: 60641 · Chicago, IL
findings: ZIP 60641 (Chicago) has 142 nonprofit organizations. 71 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 51 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60641 (Chicago) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
